description: This script generates dynamic loaders for various graphics API binding interfaces such as EGL, GL, and WGL. It creates header and source files for function pointers and loader functions based on XML registry data.

methods.name: write_header
methods.description: Generates a header file with function pointer declarations for a specified API.

methods.name: write_source
methods.description: Generates a source file that loads function pointers for a specified API.

methods.name: gen_libegl_loader
methods.description: Generates loader files for EGL API based on registry XML data.

methods.name: gen_gl_loader
methods.description: Generates loader files for OpenGL ES and extension APIs.

methods.name: gen_egl_loader
methods.description: Generates loader files for EGL API with multiple versions.

methods.name: gen_wgl_loader
methods.description: Generates loader files for WGL API extensions and versions.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point that triggers loader generation or outputs input/output file lists based on command-line arguments.
